import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Read source
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Dedup: keep LAST row per meter_id
    # Since we sorted by meter_id, read_ts, read_seq ascending,
    # the LAST occurrence of each meter_id is the latest read
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["meter_id"], keep="last")
    
    # Aggregate: group by zone, sum kwh, count rows
    # NULL zone is treated as a real group (one output row with NULL key)
    agg_df = df.groupby("zone", dropna=False).agg(
        total_kwh=("kwh", "sum"),
        meter_count=("*", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Rename columns to match output schema
    agg_df.columns = ["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]
    
    return {"zone_totals": agg_df}
